'''Team One''' was a unit of two [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] who took part in [[Operation Peacemaker]] on the [[Combat Moon]]. They worked with the [[Rabaanite]] turncoat [[Andos Delvaren]] to try and kill [[Mika Streev]].<ref name="AJ9" />
